description: This file contains the security configuration for the insurance management backend application, setting up JWT-based stateless authentication, role-based access control, and related security beans.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up security components including password encoding, user details service, authentication management, and security filter chain with JWT support.

methods.name: passwordEncoder
methods.description: Provides a BCrypt password encoder for hashing passwords.

methods.name: userDetailsService
methods.description: Provides a custom user details service backed by the application's user repository.

methods.name: authenticationManager
methods.description: Creates an AuthenticationManager bean using DAO authentication provider with user details service and password encoder.

methods.name: filterChain
methods.description: Configures the HTTP security, including CSRF disabling, session management, request authorization, and JWT filter integration.
